collection.title: Citroen C3 Pluriel 2003 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C3 Pluriel 2003 to 2012 model requires a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 18" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. There is also the option to upgrade to the newer Retrofit type wiper blade.
